title: Anyone else notice this before entering Mall World?
content: I’ve been noticing something weird right before I enter Mall World, and I’m curious if anyone else experiences the same thing. Right before I shift in, a random part of my body will stiffen up, like my hand, jaw, or just some random spot. Sometimes (not always), I’ll feel or hear this deep vibration, almost like a helicopter or something shaking. Also, right before I fully enter, I’ll sometimes catch faint mumbling, but I can never make out the words. Other times, I hear music or chanting, but again, no clear details. Does anyone else get this? Or something similar?
